    About aspirin

    Aspirin is an inexpensive drug used to treat mild pain and fever. It is also used as directed by a doctor to prevent and to treat heart attacks, to prevent strokes and blood clots, and to treat arthritis or inflammation. Aspirin is only available as an over-the-counter medication.

    Get Aspirin for as low as $4.48, save up to 80% off the average retail price for the most common version, by using a GoodRx coupon.
